python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0037.png").convert("RGB"))
# Blue cylinder is right in front!
# Let find bottom center of blue cylinder
blue_mask = (img[:, :, 2] > 150) & (img[:, :, 0] < 50)
pts = np.argwhere(blue_mask)
print(f"Blue pixels: {len(pts)}")
min_u = pts[:, 1].min()
max_u = pts[:, 1].max()
max_v = pts[:, 0].max()
bottom_pts = pts[pts[:, 0] == max_v, 1]
center_u = (min_u + max_u) / 2.0
bottom_u = bottom_pts.mean()
print(f"u range: [{min_u}, {max_u}], center_u={center_u:.1f}, bottom_u={bottom_u:.1f}, max_v={max_v}")

# Camera pose after frame 37:
# frame 36: x=0.067, y=3.982, th=45
# frame 37 requested: turn_deg=45 -> th=90 deg (+x direction)
# move_m=0.5 along 90 deg -> dx = 0.5*sin(90)=0.5, dy = 0.5*cos(90)=0.0
# xc = 0.067 + 0.5 = 0.567, yc = 3.982
xc, yc, th = 0.567, 3.982, np.radians(90.0)
f, H = 256.0, 1.55

Zc = f * H / (max_v - 256.0)
Xc = (center_u - 256.0) * H / (max_v - 256.0)
Xw = xc + Xc * np.cos(th) + Zc * np.sin(th)
Yw = yc - Xc * np.sin(th) + Zc * np.cos(th)
print(f"Blue cylinder metric position: Xw={Xw:.3f}, Yw={Yw:.3f}, Zc={Zc:.3f}, Xc={Xc:.3f}")
'
